description: Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy and domain mapping of P. putida MlaD (Q88P92)
code:
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

seq = ("MQNRTLEIGVGLFLLAGILALLLLALRVSGLSASPSSDTYKVYAYFDNIAGLTVRAKVTM"
       "AGVTIGKVTAIDLDRDSYTGRVTLQLDKSVDNLPTDSTASILTAGLLGEKYIGISVGGED"
       "EVLKDGATIHDTQSALVLEDLIGKFLLNSVGKEPKEAQPAN")
print("Length:", len(seq))

# Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy
kd = {'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,
      'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,'L':3.8,'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,
      'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
w=19
vals=[np.mean([kd[a] for a in seq[i:i+w]]) for i in range(len(seq)-w+1)]
centers=[i+w//2+1 for i in range(len(vals))]
peak=int(np.argmax(vals))
print(f"Max KD hydropathy window (w={w}): center residue ~{centers[peak]}, score {vals[peak]:.2f}")
# TM helices generally >1.6 mean KD over 19-window
above=[c for c,v in zip(centers,vals) if v>1.6]
if above:
    print("Predicted TM region (KD>1.6) spans approx residues:", min(above),"-",max(above))

# Domain map (from UniProt/InterPro)
print("\nDomain architecture (Q88P92, 161 aa):")
print("  ~1-8    : N-terminal cytoplasmic tail")
print("  ~9-31   : predicted single transmembrane helix (hydrophobic, inner membrane anchor)")
print("  39-116  : Mce/MlaD domain (Pfam PF02470) - beta-barrel MCE fold")
print("  ~117-161: C-terminal region (helical/oligomerization + pore contributions)")

# Composition checks characteristic of MlaD domain (Gly-rich, Cys-poor)
from collections import Counter
c=Counter(seq)
print("\nGly fraction:", round(c['G']/len(seq),3), "| Cys count:", c['C'])
print("Most hydrophobic stretch (res 9-31):", seq[8:31])

plt.figure(figsize=(9,3.5))
plt.plot(centers, vals, color='navy')
plt.axhline(1.6, color='red', ls='--', lw=0.8, label='TM threshold (1.6)')
plt.axvspan(39,116, color='orange', alpha=0.2, label='Mce/MlaD domain (PF02470)')
plt.xlabel('Residue'); plt.ylabel('Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy (w=19)')
plt.title('P. putida MlaD (Q88P92): N-terminal TM anchor + periplasmic MCE domain')
plt.legend(fontsize=8); plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('mlaD_hydropathy.png', dpi=120)
print("\nSaved hydropathy plot.")
